Container.Name: Grafana
Container.Overview: Grafana is an open source, feature rich metrics dashboard and graph editor for Graphite, Elasticsearch, OpenTSDB, Prometheus and InfluxDB. Prepared by the Unraid Secretary Office's consultant: the Prometheus data source and the office's dashboard are there at the first start. The admin password below is optional: left empty, Grafana starts with admin/admin and asks for a new password at the first login - set one before Grafana can be reached from outside.

Config.Name: GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL
Config.Description: The address Grafana is reached at

Config.Name: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional: the password of Grafana's user admin. Empty: admin/admin - Grafana asks for a new one at the first login. Read at the very first start only; later you change it in Grafana.

Config.Name: GF_PATHS_PROVISIONING
Config.Description: Data sources and dashboards Grafana sets up at every start (inside the appdata folder above)

Config.Name: GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED
Config.Description: true: anyone who reaches Grafana may look at the dashboards without logging in (not change them)

Config.Name: GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ORG_ROLE
Config.Description: What anonymous visitors may do (Viewer: look only)

Config.Name: Installed by
Config.Description: A note of the Unraid Secretary Office: its consultant prepared this container. Changes nothing.
